items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: And playing with Sammy Davis, oh I have a good story for you. I only did one week with Sammy Davis and the music would be piled up this high, and we would rehearse the — George Rhodes I think was the orchestra that I played with.

ctx.x: Like a plant you know. So it’s fun to watch that kind of showbiz.

Oh sure. The best I think I have to say, talking about different people, Sammy Davis Jr. was one of the most fabulous entertainers in the world I think, as far as entertaining. He did everything. And playing with Sammy Davis, oh I have a good story for you. I only did one week with Sammy Davis and the music would be piled up this high, and we would rehearse the — George Rhodes I think was the orchestra that I played with. And we would have all the charts set for the show. Sammy would come out and start the show…
That is really hard to do, to keep your eye on the music when you’re playing with some legend out there.
